limitations: This is analysis of prior retained data, not a new native execution, acceptance decision, or optimization result.
External ZIP digests and source revision bind the inputs; separate GitHub-origin and source-to-Git review remain required.
Whole-context active cycles and macroinstructions cannot be assigned to individual kernels or model stages.
Simulated cycles and modeled request bytes are not physical time, bandwidth, power, energy, or host DMA traffic.
Logical payload bytes exclude module and control traffic; their arithmetic ratio is not a memory-controller roofline intensity.
All warm-ups are validated and retained, but only the five measured samples contribute to descriptive statistics.
Each invocation has a fresh process and device context; this experiment does not establish warm-cache or steady-state reuse.
Host process duration includes supervisor, startup, validation, instrumentation and cleanup overhead; polling may delay observing exit.
Host and event intervals may overlap. No observer time is subtracted, no overlapping durations are summed, and no polling delay is corrected retrospectively.
Five measured samples establish neither confidence intervals nor production tail latency; all samples and outliers are preserved.
Diagnostics do not identify a causal bottleneck. P06-A02/A03 and vendor, RTL, synthesis, FPGA and silicon obligations remain separate.

limitations: The manifest defines workloads; only actual execution and independent review can establish acceptance.
SimX counters describe the timing model, not physical device speed, bandwidth, power or energy.
One fresh-process warm-up does not warm the following device context or establish steady-state reuse.
Whole-context counters include setup and transfers and cannot be divided into per-kernel or model-stage costs.
Cache-port bank-arbitration counters reset on each launch and are excluded from whole-context totals; local-memory and external-memory stall counters have separate cumulative lifetimes.
Host intervals include instrumentation and numerical checks; nested intervals overlap and must not be added or subtracted as exclusive costs.
Cache and external-memory requests have their own boundaries and are not useful tensor payload bytes.
Capability memory sizes are configured apertures, not observed physical memory capacity.
Five measured samples establish no tail distribution, physical-speed comparison or optimization result.
P06-A02/A03, vendor XRT integration, physical FPGA, synthesis and silicon remain separate obligations.
